name: Docker image build

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - v*

jobs:
  build-and-push-image:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU for multi-arch builds
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # 提取镜像标签（单镜像）
      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          tags: |
            type=semver,pattern={{version}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}.{{minor}}
            type=semver,pattern={{major}}
            type=edge,branch=main

      # 构建并推送多架构镜像
      - name: Build and push Docker image (Multi-Arch)
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile
          push: true
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64/v8
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}

I need precise facts about the OpenAI Codex CLI session rollout JSONL format (files like ~/.codex/sessions/.../rollout-*.jsonl), from the current source in https://github.com/openai/codex (Rust, under codex-rs/). Please read the source files (use raw.githubusercontent.com URLs on the main branch, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/models.rs and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openai/codex/main/codex-rs/protocol/src/protocol.rs ; find other files via https://github.com/openai/codex/tree/main/codex-rs if paths moved) and answer with exact field names / serde tags:

1. RolloutItem / RolloutLine: top-level JSON shape of each line (`timestamp`, `type`, `payload`?) and the list of `type` values (session_meta, response_item, event_msg, turn_context, compacted...).
2. ResponseItem enum variants and their serialized `type` tags and fields: message (role, content blocks input_text/output_text), reasoning (summary items shape, content, encrypted_content), local_shell_call (action shape: command array, workdir...), function_call (name, arguments as JSON string?, call_id), function_call_output (call_id, output: string or object? FunctionCallOutputPayload serialization — is it a plain string, or {content, success}, or array content items?), custom_tool_call (name, input, call_id), custom_tool_call_output (call_id, output), web_search_call, etc.
3. How the apply_patch tool is exposed: freeform custom tool (input = raw patch text) vs function tool with JSON {"input": "..."}; the patch grammar headers ("*** Begin Patch", "*** Add File:", "*** Update File:", "*** Delete File:", "*** Move to:", "@@", "*** End of File", "*** End Patch") and whether paths are relative or absolute.
4. Shell tool names and argument shapes: `shell` (command: array of strings, workdir, timeout_ms), `shell_command` (command: string?), `exec_command` (cmd: string?, workdir...), `write_stdin`, `local_shell`. Also update_plan, view_image.
5. Exact text format of shell tool outputs as sent back to the model: the JSON-string form {"output": ..., "metadata": {"exit_code", "duration_seconds"}} and the newer plaintext form ("Exit code: N\nWall time: ...\nOutput:\n..." or "Process exited with code N" / "Chunk ID" / "Original token count"). Which tool produces which. Quote the format strings.
6. EventMsg variants written to rollouts that matter: user_message (message, images), agent_message (message), agent_reasoning, exec_command_end (call_id, exit_code, stdout, aggregated_output...), patch_apply_end (call_id, success, changes?), token_count. Which event_msg types are actually persisted to the rollout file (there is a filter, e.g. should_persist_event_msg / is_persisted_response_item in rollout policy.rs).
7. In user messages recorded as response_item role=user, what injected prefixes appear (e.g. "<environment_context>", "<user_instructions>", "# AGENTS.md instructions for", "<INSTRUCTIONS>", "<user_shell_command>", "<turn_aborted>")? Quote the exact tag strings.

Be concrete and quote code snippets where relevant. If something can't be confirmed from source, say so explicitly.

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7

# =========================================================
# Stage 1 — Frontend build (Nuxt static)
# =========================================================
FROM docker.io/library/node:24-alpine AS frontend-builder

WORKDIR /frontend

# 使用 corepack 提供 pnpm（更稳定）
RUN corepack enable

# 先复制依赖文件（最大化缓存）
COPY web/package.json web/pnpm-lock.yaml ./

# pnpm cache
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.pnpm-store \
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

# 再复制源码
COPY web/ .

# 生成静态站点
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.pnpm-store \
    pnpm run generate



# =========================================================
# Stage 2 — Backend build (Spring Boot)
# =========================================================
FROM docker.io/library/gradle:jdk25-alpine AS backend-builder

WORKDIR /backend

# 先复制 Gradle 配置
COPY server/build.gradle.kts .
COPY server/settings.gradle.kts .
COPY server/gradle ./gradle

# 下载依赖（缓存）
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/home/gradle/.gradle \
    gradle dependencies --no-daemon || true

# 再复制源码
COPY server/src ./src

# 构建 jar
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/home/gradle/.gradle \
    gradle bootJar --no-daemon



# =========================================================
# Stage 3 — Runtime image
# =========================================================
FROM docker.io/library/eclipse-temurin:25-jdk-noble AS runtime

ENV TZ=Asia/Shanghai

# 安装运行依赖
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y nginx supervisor wget tzdata \
 && ln -snf /usr/share/zoneinfo/$TZ /etc/localtime \
 && echo $TZ > /etc/timezone \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# 复制 Spring Boot jar
COPY --from=backend-builder /backend/build/libs/*.jar /app/app.jar

# 复制 Nuxt 静态资源
COPY --from=frontend-builder /frontend/.output/public /usr/share/nginx/html

# 创建目录
RUN mkdir -p /app/data /app/logs \
 && rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default \
 && rm -f /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf

# 复制配置
COPY docker/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/app.conf
COPY docker/supervisord.conf /etc/supervisord.conf

EXPOSE 80 8080

# 默认配置（生产建议由 compose 覆盖）
ENV DB_HOST=localhost \
    DB_PORT=3306 \
    DB_NAME=entire-dashboard \
    DB_USERNAME=root \
    DB_PASSWORD=REDACTED \
    REDACTED \
    APP_USERNAME=admin \
    APP_PASSWORD=admin \
    JAVA_OPTS="-XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75 -XX:+UseZGC"

# 健康检查
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=10s --start-period=60s --retries=3 \
    CMD wget -q -O - http://localhost:80/ || exit 1

CMD ["/usr/bin/supervisord", "-c", "/etc/supervisord.conf"]
